player_0.content: I got stuck in a loop between the Foyer and the Bathroom, repeatedly going east and then west without realizing I was revisiting the Foyer. I failed to track which rooms I had already visited, leading me to stop prematurely in the Foyer while unvisited rooms (like the Kitchen or others reachable from the Foyer) remained. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms. When I enter a room I have already been to, I will immediately check the available directions for any new, unvisited rooms instead of stopping. If no new rooms are found after checking all directions, I will then decide to stop.
